note: [LLM critic, high conf] The AI declares an 8% charge on a 6 HP character and leaves the center objective for a likely failed move, because the charge score is positive only through inflated damage and bonus terms. Fix: Multiply the damage, wipe, halve and character terms by charge probability. Add a hard minimum charge probability, about 25 percent unless the target is critical. Subtract a cost for leaving a held objective. Do not apply the aggression bonus to charges below the threshold.
